Analysis by Richard Cowan

Health Canada has never really accepted the idea of medical cannabis, and neither has the

Canadian medical establishment.

The government and the quacks have played an obstructionist role at every step, until

forced to comply by the courts. It is a long and complex story that really makes no sense,

but they have gotten away with it for years.

See

Philippe Lucas’ Analysis of the Consequences of Health Canada’s Failure to Obey the

Ontario Court’s Ruling On Medical Cannabis. Is Cannabis Legal in Canada?

and

Health Canada Escalates Its War on the Sick and Dying as the Canadian Cannabis War

Heats Up. Challenges Set In the BC Courts.

and

Canadian Medical Cannabis Patients Denounce Health Canada’s War On Sick And

Dying As New Survey Shows “MARIJUANA LAWS A TOTAL FAILURE”

and

“Teens See Marijuana As Less Harmful Than Cigarettes.” Oh, The Horror! Is Health

Canada Dangerous to the Health of Canada’s Teens?

Now a ruling by an Ontario based Federal Court has struck down as “arbitrary” Health

Canada’s requirement that a designated grower could only grow for one patient. One

patient, one grower. Period.

Of course, it is difficult for a patient to find a qualified grower who is willing and able to go

through the hassle to supply just one person, but the patients’ interest have always been

subordinated to the perceived needs of the prohibitionist police.

"In my view it is not tenable for the government, consistently with the right established in

other courts for qualified medical users to have reasonable access to marijuana, to force

them either to buy from the government contractor, grow their own or be limited to the

unnecessarily restrictive system of designated producers," Judge Barry Strayer wrote.

The decision called the restriction unconstitutional and arbitrary, because it "caused

individuals a major difficulty with access. . ."

Consequently, Health Canada must reconsider requests made by a group of patients who

sued to be able to designate a single supplier as their grower.

Under HC’s restrictive rules, patients who could not grow their own or find their own

designated grower are also allowed to buy cannabis from the government, but less than

20% of patients actually use the government's cannabis. It has been very widely criticized

for its poor quality. Many have actually sent it back.

Recently, it was used as the single sample of cannabis in a test that supposedly proved that

cannabis smoke is more dangerous than tobacco smoke – except for nicotine, the dangers of

which are always minimized.

See

Annotated NORML Weekly News for December 20, 2007. Pediatricians Oppose

Random Testing of Students. Vaporizing New Smoke Hazard Claims.

And from 2005, this was to be the distribution system,

We Are Winning! Health Canada Will Try Selling Medical Marijuana in Pharmacies.

(NextYear) Politically Very Important, Medically and Scientifically Absurd. Cheaper

Than Sativex? Bad News for GW?

The government will probably appeal, but their recalcitrance puts the entire structure of

prohibition at risk. They don’t care about the patients, but prohibition is dear to them.

This ruling comes as the Tory minority government plans to introduce legislation that

would have a mandatory jail sentence for any grower. More on that soon.
